entities.summary: Jean-Claude Chermann is a French virologist who managed the research team which, by 1983, under the administrative supervision of Luc Montagnier, had discovered the virus associated with AIDS. Whereas second author of this initial publication and obviously involved as team manager in this discovery, he had been omitted from the Nobel Prize attributed to its colleagues. Jean-Claude Chermann was a physicians & medical pioneers from Paris (b. 1939-03-23, Paris). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
